title: Settings
importDescription: Select a previous downloaded settings file. Only existing keys will be updated.

messages.unsavedChangesWarning: You have unsaved changes in your settings. Are you sure you want to leave without saving?

rememberToSave: Remember to click {save} after making changes.

pollInterval.description: How often the trigger queue worker looks for pending jobs, in minutes. New jobs still start immediately when an event fires. Requires a server restart.

intervalSeconds.description: Time between statistics snapshots, from 1 to 2147483 whole seconds. Default: 100. Saved changes apply without a restart.

autoDelete.description: Off by default. Enabling this permanently deletes existing and future dated statistics CSV files older than the retention cutoff. Other files are preserved.

retentionDays.description: Used only when automatic deletion is enabled. Default: 30 days; range: 1–36500. Files dated before today (UTC) minus this many days are deleted at startup, after settings changes, and daily.

pgStats.invalidValue: Enter a whole collection interval between 1 and 2147483 seconds, a retention period between 1 and 36500 days, and true or false for automatic deletion.
